dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' shaped perimeters with sharp gradient transitions from high-intensity outer rings to low-intensity internal cores; most distinct structures are elongated along the vertical axis in the center-left field with continuous, well-defined pixel boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated in the upper-left quadrant; lower density of isolated solid-intensity clusters interspersed between the larger macro-annuli across the central dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-section form a distorted trapezoidal polygon; a linear chain of three smaller 'O' structures follows a curved path from the lower-left to the bottom-center terminal.
